review.decision: Cover the three ordering defects from independent review before implementing the revision
review.notes: Keep the original intent ID, raw observations and historical receipts immutable. Verify the later association at request, reply and current time, and never convert prior attempts into a fresh submission.

cases.description: A verified user confirmation may supplement an unattempted saved action while its identity and original authorization history remain intact.
cases.setup: Save a responsibility first; receive and clear a real user answer later, or verify a legacy original direct instruction.
cases.action: Review the existing action and bind a current supplemental authority citation. Try a stale answer or unconfirmed event, and retry an already attempted action.
cases.expected: Only a reviewed exact current authority permits the original unused action to submit once. Submitted or uncertain work remains reserved.

cases.description: A request observed before membership retains its original provenance and an explicitly reviewed, temporally unique attribution.
cases.setup: Ingest a request and reply before enrolling the author. Backdate the exact history or create an ambiguous or unrelated member.
cases.action: Bind the receipt through verified HQ, reload, inspect original and attribution and try wrong or ambiguous targets.
cases.expected: Only a unique continuous exact source joins. Original observations remain immutable and a durable attribution identifies the same receipt.

cases.description: A prior ordinary queued or landed drive stays distinguishable from a new receipt reminder.
cases.setup: An ordinary synthetic drive has a saved receipt before HQ reviews the inbox.
cases.action: Bind the same action, run another drive pass, reopen, and inspect responsibility text and submission count.
cases.expected: Reconciliation identifies the original delivery, reports zero fresh reminders, and still requires source execution evidence.
